style: Dedicated candy paper backdrop; matte 2D pastel; 1:2 native aspect; no gloss

assets.mochi-draw-panel.png: Use case: illustration-story. Production background image for a cozy Korean mobile puzzle game's GACHA / skin draw screen. Create a NEW distinct design, not a victory frame. Very tall portrait aspect ratio EXACTLY 1:2 (1024 by 2048 preferred), for a tall mobile panel. Beautiful understated hand-painted 2D gouache and colored-pencil illustration on warm cream paper. A soft pale lavender outer edge, rounded rectangular paper card silhouette with generous rounded corners, transparent alpha outside the card. A tiny cozy candy atelier atmosphere suggested ONLY by small matte paper-cut candy wrappers, flat five-point star confetti, softly drawn dots, and a few little scalloped paper cloud scraps at the outermost top and bottom corners. Main palette warm ivory, muted lilac, powder peach, small butter-yellow accents. No large stars, no bubbles, no pearls, no jewel effects, no glitter, no radiant lighting. The middle 80 percent is very quiet, near-uniform light cream paper with delicate fine grain, completely EMPTY for animated capsule, rewards and live UI text. Top central title area and bottom central button area also empty. All decorations small and sparse, within outer 8 percent margins, keep everything low contrast enough for readable overlaid UI. No central scene, no podium, no capsule, no characters, no letters, no text, no numbers, no buttons. Visual quality: polished storybook stationery, tactile powdery matte illustration with fine subtle pencil contours and at most two flat paint tones. STRICTLY FLAT 2D, not 3D, no shiny plastic, no glossy highlights, no bevel, no realistic render, no specular reflections, no volumetric shading, no lens flare, no gradients suggesting inflation. Preserve a calm playful spacious composition. True transparent exterior, no checkerboard.
assets.mochi-capsule.png: Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is edit target: cute lavender/peach gacha capsule sprite. Image 2 is style reference ONLY: matte 2D pastel clear panel. Redraw ONLY the capsule from image 1 as a matte flat 2D gouache/pastel illustrated sticker, matching image 2. Preserve the near-round silhouette, front-on orthographic view, position/scale and existing straight seam at 54.5 percent of image height measured from top (45.5 percent from bottom), because game splits here to open two halves. Entire capsule fits with clear margins. Upper shell muted lavender, lower shell cream peach, a butter-yellow flat star on upper shell, two tiny dark plum eyes and small smile and flat blush on bottom shell. Thin gently hand-drawn lavender outline, subtle paper grain, powdery matte paint, at most two-tone restrained edge shading. Absolutely no glossy white specular spots or streaks, no pearlescent rainbow rim, no translucent glass, no beveled star, no realistic volumetric sphere shading, no 3D render. The star is painted on, not embossed. Preserve joyful expression but eyes flat dark shapes with only tiny pale eye dots if necessary. No surrounding objects, no text, no backdrop, no cast shadow. Genuine alpha transparency outside capsule, smooth antialiased edges, clean polished illustration.
